notes.title: Teslagrad 2 Nominated for an Annie Award!
notes.notes:
The team behind Teslagrad 2 were honored to be nominated for the prestigious "Annie's", an award honoring excellence in the field of animation.
The Annie Awards have been honoring film and television since 1972, but more recently, videogames also got their own category!

All the winners and nominees can be viewed [url=https://annieawards.org/winners]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42854841/6b7a1429e1cce0ec2c6c9aee5509b29501792b78.png[/img]

Alas, we did not win, but with such esteemed company among the nominees, we're more than happy for the recognition :)
Thank you to ASIFA Hollywood for recognising our work, and particular congratulations to our great animators Aslak Helgesen & Kristine Teksle!

notes.title: September 8th Update
notes.notes:
Hi Teslamancers! We've just released a patch to fix some issues in the game. 

Major:
- Fixed a soft lock issue around the Viking airship that would make players fall off the map. The soft lock won't happen in the future, and affected saves can now backtrack to the area and continue the game. Sorry to everyone affected!

Minor:
- Fixed multiple issues arising from dying to the Big Snake.
- Level loading times have been improved
- Solidified a soft piece of dirt that occasionally caused players to sink through the level by the pier in the Hub
- The main menu sidebar has been updated.

notes.title: Here’s everything announced at Nintendo’s Indie World Showcase
notes.notes:
Nintendo’s Indie World Showcase aired last night, showing off more than a dozen interesting, indie titles that’ll be coming to the Nintendo Switch during 2023. The clue is in the name when it comes to what was on display; indie titles.

So, if you’re looking for a morsel of hope that Hollow Knight: Silksong is happening this summer, I have to sadly break it to you that no, it did not show up at the showcase. That said, plenty of other games shown off might tide you over until we eventually, one day, receive an update on Silksong.

You can watch the Indie World Showcase over on Nintendo’s website, but for those who prefer to read a round-up, I’ve got you covered.

Read more

notes.title: Teslagrad 2 is out NOW!
notes.notes:
Greetings brave Teslamancers, 

After years of work, sweat, caffeine and plenty of fond memories, we’re finally able to say that Teslagrad 2 is available for play! 

[previewyoutube=LnWJCg2XDMk;full][/previewyoutube]

Come, discover Wyrmheim. Uncover its secrets, meet the locals and embark on your brand-new adventure! Challenges and secrets abound, but we’re sure you’ll face them with the boldness and gusto of a true Teslamancer!

Now, there are so many we would like to give thanks to. Family and friends that have kept us safe and sane through the bad times, as well as the good. And, of course, a HUGE thank you to YOU. The Fans. For your patience, passion and support. Your continued excitement has kept us going and striving towards ever-great heights. Looking back at what we’ve been able to build, we’re thrilled to finally have you experience it as well, and join us at the top of the Tower!

We’ve kept you for long enough. Strap on your boots, and face the world of Teslagrad once again. Let us know what you discover.


Regards, 

Your Rain Games and Modus Games teams

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1698220/Teslagrad_2/

notes.title: Teslagrad 2 Next Fest Video Stream #2
notes.notes:
[h2]Calling all aspiring Teslamancers! [/h2]

Join developer Rain Games for an electrifying look at the Teslagrad 2 demo, which will be available to download and play during "Steam Next Fest: February 2023" from February 6 through February 13.

During the video stream you'll be introduced to the brave Teslamancer, Lumina (some of you may recognize from World to the West) whose airship crash lands in Wyrmheim after being blasted out of the sky by a band of vicious Vikings. Lumina has no choice but to forge ahead through this unfamiliar but mystical land in a game built around fascinating electromagnetic physics and filled with plenty of rewarding puzzle-based challenges to overcome and new abilities and secrets to discover.
